text:
lina: Heads-up: external assessor confirmed for Tue 07:00 UTC. Scope: staging cluster + a read-only slice of prod telemetry and metrics. Requested deliverables: RBAC export (bindings + last-active), KMS key policy + usage audit for key-id k-0a1b2c, and audit logs for the last 30 days. Who will own each export?
omar: I can own the audit export (CloudTrail + KMS metric logs). Plan: export to a signed tarball, add a manifest with file SHA256s, and GPG-sign the bundle. Need to know PII policy and presigned link retention.
tess: PII must be removed before handoff. Use the redaction job: s3://ops-exports/pt-redact/ and produce a mapping file hashed with sha256(email) kept in Vault. Do NOT ship raw emails or plaintext IPs marked as internal.
raj: For RBAC: I'll produce a snapshot with role and policy attachments, principal last-active timestamps, and the change history for bindings (if available). Confirming: no credentials, no tokens, only metadata and policy documents.
lina: Correct. Also add the name of the last modifier and commit id where the binding was changed (if in git).
samir: pentest-bot uploaded the intake checklist -> https://files.redwood/pentest/intake_v2.pdf :white_check_mark:
omar: KMS detail: assessor requested key usage records for k-0a1b2c. We can include CloudWatch events for Encrypt/Decrypt, plus the key policy document. Proposed safety: create an ephemeral alias alias/pt-2026-03 and restrict key usage to pt-assessor role + ops during the window.
tess: Agree to alias approach. We'll set explicit key policy allowing only the alias and ops IAM principals and set a disable rule for non-essential principals for the duration. Keep older alias for rollback purposes.
raj: I'll craft pt-assessor role with minimal privileges (kms:DescribeKey, kms:Decrypt for target alias, and read-only on specified buckets). Will include a condition limiting by source IP and require MFA. After the window we remove the role.
lina: Include rollback steps and CLI commands in the runbook. We need a reproducible script for grant and revoke.
raj: Runbook fragment:
```
# create assessor role
aws iam create-role --role-name pt-assessor --assume-role-policy-document file://assume-pt.json
aws iam put-role-policy --role-name pt-assessor --policy-name pt-assessor-policy --policy-document file://pt-assessor-policy.json

# create ephemeral KMS alias
aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/pt-2026-03 --target-key-id k-0a1b2c

# revoke after test
aws iam delete-role --role-name pt-assessor
aws kms delete-alias --alias-name alias/pt-2026-03
```
omar: Export plan: produce gzipped tar with manifest (sha256 per file) and create a GPG signature. Push to s3://pt-archive/<engagement>/ and provide presigned GET links valid for 10 days. Any objections to 10-day window?
tess: Ten days OK. SIEM will replace user identifiers with hashed ids and keep the mapping in Vault for 90 days. Also strip any internal-only IP tokens.
samir: Assessor submitted an evidence request for KMS grants and CloudTrail events around auth failures. I appended it to the checklist.
raj: I'll publish a lightweight verifier script in the ops repo so the assessor can run a smoke-check: https://github.com/redwood/ops-scripts/blob/main/pt/assessor-verify.sh. It will assume the pt-assessor role and attempt read-only queries against allowed resources.
lina: Triage & remediation during the engagement: open findings in the vuln board under label 'pt-assessment'. Critical hits: page on-call SRE immediately; high/medium: create triage ticket and assign an owner for 48h SLA. Use #pt-triage for live coordination.
omar: Telemetry access: provide presigned URLs to specific objects. Do not include server-side encryption keys in manifests; only include key-id and alias in policy docs.
tess: Exported logs should be redacted at source: replace user emails with sha256(email) and mark internal IPs as <internal-ip-REDACTED>. Keep a sealed mapping in Vault for incident follow-up.
raj: Proposed retest verification windows: Wed 14:00 UTC (omar covering) and Thu 09:00 UTC (tess covering). Need eng-security + SRE present for validation. Who else can join?
omar: I can take Wed slot.
tess: I can take Thu slot.
lina: Good. I'll assemble a verification matrix (owner, path, how-to-verify, rollback commands) and post it before EOD today.
omar: One last ask: include an integrity checksum for the final tarball and include the exact export command used in the runbook so we can reproduce later.
raj: Verifier snippet I'm adding to repo:
```
set -e
# verify manifest checksums
sha256sum -c manifest.sha256
# assume role and run smoke tests
creds=$(aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor --role-session-name pt-check)
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo $creds | jq -r .Credentials.AccessKeyId)
export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo $creds | jq -r .Credentials.SecretAccessKey)
export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo $creds | jq -r .Credentials.SessionToken)
./assessor-verify.sh
```
lina: Action items summary:
- raj: RBAC export, pt-assessor role, runbook + verifier script
- omar: audit log export, manifest + signature, presigned links, retention window
- tess: KMS alias work, redaction pipeline, SIEM mapping to hashed ids
- samir: assessor liaison and checklist owner

lina: Final pre-engagement sync Mon 06:00 UTC. Thanks all :thumbsup:
